sources.name: DelimitedText2
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> DelimitedText2

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared DelimitedText2 = let
  AdfDoc = AzureStorage.BlobContents("https://gbsa.blob.core.windows.net/datafactory/0e15ec7e-5442-9a4c-8f40-b1dfe0195d89_0.txt"),
  Csv = Csv.Document(AdfDoc, [Delimiter = ",", Encoding = TextEncoding.Utf8, QuoteStyle = QuoteStyle.Csv]),
  PromotedHeaders = Table.PromoteHeaders(Csv, [PromoteAllScalars = true])
in
  PromotedHeaders;
shared UserQuery = let
  Source = DelimitedText2,
  #"Split column by delimiter" = Table.SplitColumn(Source, "OperationItem", Splitter.SplitTextByDelimiter(","), {"Facility_UID", "Facility Name", "Venue Type", "Address1", "Address2", "City", "State", "Zip", "Zip+4", "Country", "Venue Phone", "Venue Notes", "Venue Capacity"})
in
  #"Split column by delimiter";
